name: Morse.exp
why: Project: γ(1) for a chosen geodesic on an open (-δ,1+δ) with γ(0)=q, γ'(0)=v, else q; blind: γ(1) for a chosen geodesic on the closed [0,1] (right derivative v), else q. Equal everywhere, junk value included: a blind geodesic on [0,1] extends to an open interval (extend_closed, copied from V7_20, via Morse.exists_localFlow_exp), a project one restricts, so the existence conditions agree, and the values agree by uniqueness (Morse.IsGeodesicFrom.exp_eq). Tangent spaces via the copied tsp_eq.
